name: Otto II, Holy Roman Emperor
contribution: Holy Roman Emperor from 973 until his death in 983.

checks.lead: Otto II (955 – 7 December 983), called the Red (German: der Rote), was Holy Roman Emperor from 973 until his death in 983. A member of the Ottonian dynasty, he was the youngest and sole surviving son of Otto the Great and Adelaide of Italy.
